notes.title: Key Bindings and Audio Update
notes.content:
We have released an exciting new update that brings brand new in game VFX that indicate the zombie you are targeting.

As requested, we now have support for non-qwerty keyboards. We are continuing to refine and tweak the UI for this.

We are getting closer and closer to a final release. Our writer is working tirelessly to bring you the final 2 chapters of gameplay.

Thank you for all your support.

notes.title: The Autumn Update
notes.content:
Hey _kommandos, 
We were fortunate enough to show the game off at SIX (Seattle Indies Expo) where we received an abundance of critical and valuable feedback. It is only after painstakingly responding to that feedback that we are proud to present the Autumn Update. 

We’re packing the punch when it comes to aesthetics. Our game now supports higher resolutions including 4k. Along with these new settings, comes another pass at our in game sound effects and soundtrack. We’ve reworked the menus for a new sleek and polished look.

Upgrades have been streamlined. There’s less of them now and you can use them as traps for zombies. If a zombie walks into an upgrade they will be stunned. Shoot that stunned zombie to grab that upgrade. Beware of ragers though. One typo and they will enter rage mode, destroying every upgrade in their path.

Enter the “Endless Nightmare”, a whole new difficulty level. There is no victory in this mode, only inevitable doom. See how long you can last in this mode that never ends. With no upgrades, and only one weapon, expert typists may last more than a minute.

We added a new Tutorial menu to the game. The menu can be accessed from the Upgrades menu or the main menu. 

Finally we have added countless gameplay fixes and balance changes for a smoother game experience. If you do find any bugs, or have anything you would like to see changed or fixed, please take your suggestions to the discussion page. We’re checking it constantly and responding as fast as we can.

See you in the apockeylypse.
